title: Mistaken Detention of American Citizen by ICE Agents in Evanston
seoTitle: Mistaken Detention of American Citizen by ICE Agents in.
subtitle: ICE Agents Mistakenly Apprehend American Citizen, Leaving Him Injured on the Ground
excerpt: In Evanston, ICE agents mistakenly detained an American citizen, who was left injured on the ground, sparking new controversy over their practices.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Sunday morning, agents from the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) approached an American citizen in Evanston, a Chicago suburb, and left him on the ground with injuries to his head, neck, and teeth. The incident occurred after an anonymous tip from someone who overheard two arguments and heard that someone would be taken into custody.

How the Mistaken Detention Occurred

According to the Evanston Police Department, agents responded to a call and found two SUV trucks near an intersection. One of the occupants identified himself as a federal agent investigating the whereabouts of a fugitive. The individual was wearing civilian clothes, a vest with the inscription “POLICIA” (POLICE), and federal authority badges.

Bystanders' Reaction and Medical Attention

Several passersby helped the man after the apprehension and called an ambulance upon noticing injuries to his head, neck, and teeth. The man was taken to the hospital for treatment.

Citizen Identification and Release

Evanston police identified the individual only as a local resident and noted that he refused to identify himself, claiming resistance to detention. Subsequently, agents determined he was not the person they were looking for and confirmed he was an American citizen, releasing him.

Federal Authorities' Statements

The Department of Homeland Security stated that ICE agents were conducting a targeted enforcement operation and encountered someone who resembled their target. A DHS spokesperson declared that agents “immediately identified themselves as law enforcement officers” and that “ICE agents acted in accordance with training.” After correct identification, the agents left the scene without further incident.

Context of Immigration Crackdown

The incident is described as the latest case of an American citizen affected by the intensified immigration crackdown during the Trump administration, which included aggressive tactics by federal agents and led to lawsuits and protests. One year after “Operation Midway Blitz,” ICE's actions in Chicago and surrounding areas remain under judicial scrutiny.

With information from CNN en Español.
